summary_en: Kirin to acquire 100% of Jamieson Wellness Inc. (Canada-listed vitamin, mineral, supplement manufacturer, #1 market share in Canada VMS) via Plan of Arrangement, cash consideration for all shares. Closing subject to shareholder approval, court approval, and regulatory clearance. Strategic investment to establish North American health-science base and expand global growth platform.
title_en: Notice of Conclusion of Agreement Regarding Share Acquisition of Jamieson Wellness Inc. (Full Subsidiaryization)
translation_en_brief: Kirin Holdings announced on 7 August 2026 that it has decided to acquire 100% of Jamieson Wellness Inc., a Canada-listed vitamins, minerals, and supplements (VMS) manufacturer headquartered in Toronto, and make it a wholly owned subsidiary. The acquisition will be executed via Plan of Arrangement (POA), a statutory mechanism under Canadian law for acquiring all shares of a public company, with Kirin purchasing all outstanding shares for cash consideration. Kirin and Jamieson Wellness boards have approved the transaction, and an Arrangement Agreement defining the acquisition terms was signed on the announcement date. Completion is subject to approval by Jamieson Wellness shareholders, court approval, and satisfaction of other customary closing conditions. Jamieson Wellness is a company founded in 1922 with over 100 years of history, holds the #1 market share position in the Canadian supplement market, and strengthened its US operations through the 2022 acquisition of Nutrawise Health & Beauty Corporation (youtheory brand). Kirin identified this as a strategic priority to establish a North American health-science platform, complementing its existing Asia-Pacific base (built via Blackmores and FANCL acquisitions) and supporting its 2035 vision of becoming the world's most trusted health-science company.
